description: This file defines the RequestInterface interface within the PSR-7 HTTP message standard, specifying methods for handling HTTP request properties such as request target, method, and URI in an immutable manner.

classes.name: RequestInterface
classes.description: An interface representing an outgoing, client-side HTTP request, extending MessageInterface, with methods for managing request target, HTTP method, and URI.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the message's request target, returning a string representing it, defaulting to "/" if none is set.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP method of the request as a string.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method, ensuring case sensitivity and validity.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI associated with the request as a UriInterface instance.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided URI, optionally preserving the Host header.
